geographyValidationFinding.evidence: Queried the authoritative Supabase postcode_reference table (project aspectlead-platform, rubhjkgygauuixiqouza) directly, read-only: zero rows anywhere with code='CR1' or a code starting 'CR1' (level district, sector, or otherwise). The full real CR-area district set present in the reference data is CR0, CR2, CR3, CR4, CR5, CR6, CR7, CR8, CR9, CR90 — CR1 does not appear at all. This matches known UK postal geography: Croydon's postcode-district numbering has a genuine gap at CR1 (never allocated as a standard geographic delivery district; CR9 is Croydon's own non-geographic/PO-Box-style code).
geographyValidationFinding.actionTaken: CR1 excluded from live discovery/enrichment entirely — not run, not guessed, not substituted with a neighbouring district (CR9/CR90 were NOT added; explicitly instructed not to add neighbouring districts). Flagged prominently in the batch report for owner confirmation. This is the one blocker-class finding this batch encountered; it did not halt Alam's campaign or any other representative's work — the 3 remaining, confirmed-valid districts (CR0, CR2, CR3) were processed normally.
